name: Wincent Wolf
review:
Wincent Wolf follows two lavish Vegas players, Wincent Wolf and Scarlett Fox, through free spins, Wheel of Fortune mechanics and sticky wilds. W-marked ace cards add a mischievous touch to the 20-line game.

The wheel adds bonus outcomes, and sticky wilds give the free spins their staying power. Bonus buys are available where permitted. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 10,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 150 spins. A characterful game with a good balance of risk.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 150 spins on average)
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
